name: Heart-Water (Nam Jai)
description: How far Pricha's giving reaches and how much it is trusted. Checked when feeding someone, carrying something for another, being believed. Initial value 3 — a clerk's measured pouring.

name: Deference (Kreng Jai)
description: The art of not imposing; sparing face; approaching power correctly. Pricha's engine of failure: he loves the debate more than the room. Initial value 2.

name: The Ledger
description: The new arithmetic: accounts, wages, interest, airmail, contracts. Checked with shopkeepers, officials, the pawnshop, the state. Initial value 4.

name: Word-Hoard
description: Collected foreign and formal words, deployed exactly. Checked when teaching, debating, impressing the learned. Also his vanity. Initial value 4.

name: Merit-Water
description: Standing with the temple, the dead, and the pond. Ceremonies without error, the abbot's trust, vows. Initial value 3.
